item.text: The current code expires the per-user marker after the resend interval, while the confirmation record lasts a day. That can leave an old link valid after the marker disappears. I’m aligning both expiries to the configured link lifetime and using the marker’s live TTL to decide when resend is allowed.

item.text: The final focused tests and lint checks pass. I’ve also recorded the implementation and verification results in the checkpoint; I’m cleaning up the temporary local Redis process now.

Updated [email confirmation handling](/app/src/user/email.js) to return a strict pending state and a live TTL in milliseconds, enforce the configured resend interval, clear confirmations on expiry, and reject old codes. Added a one-day default expiry and a regression test.

Verification: 5 focused confirmation tests and 6 email API tests passed; ESLint and `git diff --check` passed.
